sections.description: The core bridge between Exacoat Manager ERP, WooCommerce orders, custom status, and fulfillment tracking.
sections.changelog:
### Version 0.0.51
- Fixed PHP fatal error in manual warranty and redeem claim creation
- Added timespan RMA analytics with Warranty and Redeem breakdowns across channels
- Separated Warranty and Redeem claims into dedicated tabs
- Expanded Shopee and TikTok synchronization limits up to 250 orders, cache retention up to 1,000, and live on-demand order lookups
